# 1051. Height Checker

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def heightChecker(self, heights):
        """
        :type heights: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        expected = sorted(heights)
        return sum(1 for x, y in zip(heights, expected) if x != y)
```
